text.p: A Reuters survey of analysts
covering Finnish equities showed a 25 million markka median
forecast for lift-maker Kone Oy's January-August profit after
financial items, before extraordinaries.
Profit after financial items
(FIM million)
Median 25
Mean 10
Lowest loss 66
Highest 50
The results are due on October 10.
In January-August 1995, Kone posted a 136 million markka
profit.
For Kone's full-year 1996 profit, seven of the 12 analysts
polled gave a median forecast profit after financial items,
before extraordinaries of 26 million markka (mean 49 million) in
a 12-140 million markka range.
Kone's 1995 profit after financial items was 202 million
markka. It said on September 19 it expected full-year 1996
earnings after tax to be "close to zero" as full-year losses at
its Italian operations would rise to almost 200 million markka.
The data was collected in the last week of September and on
October 3.
Contributors to the survey were Aros Securities, AG Private
Bankers, Aktia Bank, Alfred Berg, Carnegie, Enskilda, Erik
Selin, Evli Securities, FIM Securities, Interbank, Merita and
Opstock.
